name: Rasa Juknevičienė - Après le § 1 - Am 16
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Georgia
part_text: 1a. Acknowledges the decision of the Georgian authorities to temporarily pause the country’s EU accession process as a legitimate expression of national sovereignty in the face of foreign political pressure; respects Georgia’s reassessment of its strategic partnerships to protect its constitutional order and national interests;
